company.name: Seabreeze Landscape Construction
company.tagline: From Site Works to Finished Landscapes
company.serviceArea: Serving All of Rhode Island & Surrounding Areas

announcement.text: Seabreeze Lawncare is now Seabreeze Landscape Construction! Same local team, bigger capabilities.

services.title: Site Work & Excavation
services.description: Precision grading, trenching, foundation prep, and lot clearing using commercial machinery. Built to prepare your site right.

services.title: Patios & Walkways
services.description: Custom paver patio installations, natural stone walkways, steps, and outdoor living spaces tailored for durability and curb appeal.

services.title: Retaining Walls & Hardscaping
services.description: Engineered block walls, boulder retaining structures, and terraced gardens designed for erosion control and structural strength.

services.title: Drainage Solutions
services.description: Protect your property from water pooling and foundation damage with French drains, dry wells, pop-up emitters, and water redirection.

services.title: Land Clearing & Stump Removal
services.description: Overgrown lot clearing, brush removal, stump grinding, and gravel driveway prep to prepare space for future construction.

services.title: Lawn Renovations & Maintenance
services.description: Complete lawn re-seeding, sod installation, hydroseeding, garden bed installs, lighting, and seasonal grounds maintenance.
